spans.s:
हृद् हृद्, त्, n. (abbreviated fr. हर्द्, but
said by some to be connected with rt. 1. हृ;
it is defective in declension, being optionally substi-
tuted for हृदय in all cases except the first five
inflections or Nom. sing. du. pl., Acc. sing. du.; it
is said by some to be also masc.), the heart; the
mind, (हृद्य् अवेदिन्, ‘one who has no knowledge
or capacity of knowledge in the mind,’ applied to
animals), the soul, the faculty or seat of thought
and feeling; the interior of the body, breast, chest,
bosom; the interior or essence of anything; [cf.
Gr. κῆρ, κέαρ, καρδ-ία, κραδ-ίη; Lat. cor (cord-is),
dimin. cor-culum, cordatus, vêcors; Goth. hairt-o;
Old Germ. herza; Mod. Germ. Herz; Angl. Sax.
heorte; Eng. heart; Lith. szird-i-s; Slav. srŭ-
dĭce.]
—हृच्-छय, अस्, आ, अम् (i. e. हृद् + शय),
lying or abiding in the heart; (अस्), m. ‘heart-
dweller,’ epithet of Kāma-deva (god of love), love.
—हृच्छय-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, tormented by love,
love-sick.
—हृच्छय-वर्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, aug-
menting love.
—हृच्छयाविष्ट-चेतन (˚य-आव्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, having a heart penetrated by love.
—हृच्-
छूल, अम्, n. (i. e. हृद् + शूल), ‘heart-pang,’ any
acute internal pain, pain in the chest.
—हृच्-छोक,
अस्, m. (i. e. हृद् + शोक), heart-ache; a pang.
—हृत्-
कम्प, अस्, m. heart-throb, tremor of the heart, palpita-
tion.
—हृत्-पिण्ड, अम्, n. ‘heart-mass,’ the heart.
—हृत्-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the heart, seated
in the heart.
—हृत्स्व्-अस्, अस्, अस्, अस्, Ved. throwing
into the heart.
—हृदं-सनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. giving
the heart; receiving the heart or essence of anything;
receiving affection or kindness.
—हृद्-आवर्त, अस्,
m. a curl or lock of hair on a horse's chest.
—हृदि-
स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, ‘touching or lying in the heart,’ dear,
beloved, cherished.
—हृद्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone
to the heart, seated in the heart or mind, come to
mind, conceived, designed; cherished; (अम्), n.
anything fixed in the mind, design, meaning, intent.
—हृद्-गोल, अस्, m., N. of a mountainous district.
—हृद्गोलीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the above
[]
district; (आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of the Hṛd-gola
mountains.
—हृद्-ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘heart-seizure,’
spasm of the heart.
—हृद्-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. (accord-
ing to Śabda-k.) a heart-wound, heart-sore (= हृद्-
व्रण).
—हृद्-देश, अस्, m. the region of the
heart.
—हृद्-भेद-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tan-
tra work.
—हृद्-रुज्, क्, f. ‘heart-disease,’ grief.
—हृद्-रोग, अस्, m. heart-disease, heart-ache, heart-
burn; sorrow, grief, anguish; love; the zodiacal
sign Aquarius.
—हृद्रोग-वैरिन्, ई, m. ‘hostile
to heart-burn,’ the tree Pentaptera Arjuna.
—हृद्-
वण्टक, अस्, m. ‘partitioning the heart or chest,’
the stomach.
—हृल्-लास, अस्, m. ‘heart-sport,’
hiccough; heart-disturbance, disquietude, grief.
—हृल्-लेख, अस्, m. ‘heart-impression,’ knowledge,
reasoning; ‘heart-scratch,’ heart-ache, heart-sorrow;
(आ), f. disquietude, anxiety or regret for any absent
object.

हृदय, अम्, n. the mind, soul, seat or faculty
of thought and feeling, (चपल-हृदय, fickle-
minded); affection, love; the heart; the interior of
the body, breast, chest, bosom; the interior or centre
or essence of anything; true or divine knowledge;
the Veda; science; [cf. Gr. καρδία, &c.; Hib. croi-
dhe, cridhe, ‘the heart.’]
—हृदय-कम्प, अस्,
m. tremor or throb of the heart, palpitation.
—हृ-
दय-कम्पन, अम्, n. throbbing of the heart;
(अस्, ई, अम्), heart-stirring, heart-agitating, causing
the heart to throb (with indignation &c.).
—हृ-
दय-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. ‘heart-tie, heart-bond,’ any-
thing which binds the soul.
—हृदय-ग्राहिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, heart-captivating, engaging the affection.
—हृदयङ्-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, going to the heart,
heart-stirring, thrilling, affecting, touching, moving,
dear, beloved; (अम्), n. an apposite or appropriate
speech.
—हृदय-चौर, अस्, m. a heart-robber,
one who steals the heart or affections.
—हृदय-
च्छिद्, त्, त्, त्, heart-breaking, heart-piercing, heart-
rending.
—हृदय-दौर्बल्य, अम्, n. weakness
of heart, faintheartedness.
—हृदय-रज्जु, (in
geometry) a central line, the semidiameter of a circle
in contact with the angles of a trapezium.
—हृदय-
लेख, अस्, m. heart-impression, knowledge; ‘heart-
scratch,’ heart-ache, anxiety, (see हृल्-लेख.)
—हृ-
दय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a heart, tender-hearted,
kind, humane.
—हृदय-विध्, त्, त्, त् (विध् for
व्यध्, see rt. 2. विध्), heart-piercing.
—हृदय-
वृत्ति, इस्, f. disposition or inclination of the heart.
—हृदय-वेधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, heart-piercing, piercing
the vitals (said of an arrow).
—हृदय-शल्य, अम्,
n. a dagger or arrow in the heart, wound in the
heart.
—हृदय-शोक, अस्, m. heart-sorrow, heart-
ache, a pang of grief.
—हृदय-शोषण, अस्, ई, अम्,
heart-withering.
—हृदय-सन्निहित, अस्, आ, अम्,
placed or deposited in the heart, fixed or laid up in
the mind.
—हृदय-सम्मित, अस्, आ, अम्, breast-
high, as high as the breast.
—हृदय-साहि, इस्, m.
a proper N.
—हृदय-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in
the heart, cherished in the heart.
—हृदय-स्थान,
अम्, n. ‘seat of the heart,’ the breast, chest, bosom.
—हृदयात्मन् (˚य-आत्˚), आ, m. a heron.
—हृ-
दयामय (˚य-आम्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having sick-
ness of heart, heart-sickening.
—हृदयाम्बुज
(˚य-अम्˚), अम्, n. ‘heart-lotus,’ a lotus-like heart.
—हृदयाविध् (˚य-आव्˚), त्, त्, त्, heart-piercing.
—हृदयेश (˚य-ईश) or हृदयेश्वर (˚य-ईश्˚),
अस्, m. ‘heart-lord,’ a husband; (आ), f. ‘heart-
mistress,’ a wife; a mistress.
—हृदयोदङ्क (˚य-
उद्˚), अस्, m. upheaving or torturing the heart; (अस्,
आ, अम्), heart heaving, heart-disturbing.

हृदयालु, उस्, उस्, उ, good-hearted, tender-
hearted, affectionate, friendly.

हृदयावी, (according to some) Ved. one who
has a heart.

हृदयिक, अस्, आ, अम्, good-hearted, tender-
hearted.
हृदयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, good-hearted, tender-hearted.
हृदीक, अस्, m., N. of a Yādava king.

हृद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, hearty, cordial, proceeding
from or produced in the heart; dear to the heart,
[]
beloved, cherished, desired; affectionate, kind; grate-
ful, pleasant, agreeable; savory; (अस्), m. a Vedic
Mantra employed to effect the subjection or fascina-
tion of an enemy or rival; (आ), f. the medicinal root
called Vṛddhi; (अम्), n. the bank of the Laurus
Cassia.
—हृद्य-गन्ध, अस्, m. the Vilva tree;
(आ), f. great-flowered jasmine; (अम्), n. small
cumin; sochal salt.
—हृद्य-गन्धि, n. small
cumin.
—हृद्य-ता, f. or हृद्य-त्व, अम्, n.
cordiality, heartiness, agreeableness, delightfulness.
